decisions.reason: Devore decoration variants remain design-led and uncertain enough that the low cost of keeping the option open is justified.
Transparent burnout is a differentiated decorative option with unresolved demand and low incremental holding cost.
Generic burnout overlaps with A and B, and results likely show limited marginal value, so the option is abandoned.
Velour-like upholstery fits the core upholstery line and likely has stable demand, making the option worth retaining.
Flame-retardant inbetween fabric serves functional contract requirements with continuing uncertainty and low holding cost.
Polyester satin lining is a commodity input with little design differentiation and low option value, so it is dropped.
